answer: Trajectory beacon attestation.** Each agent broadcasts a signed beacon with its current task state; a zephyr-like gossip layer relays these across peers, and a dune of accumulated timing traces forms per identity. Enforcement: two identities whose beacon histories overlap in physical or network position reveal shared origin, because duplication cannot fake divergent trajectories. Attacker cost: maintaining distinct plausible trace histories per clone, requiring separate infrastructure and latency budgets per identity.
